verdict.rationale: Stripe provides event-driven infrastructure (webhooks, idempotent APIs) and several built-in automations (Smart Retries, revenue recovery, Radar fraud scoring) that react automatically to events, but these are largely pre-built behaviors rather than a general-purpose rules engine where a user can freely define arbitrary 'if event X then action Y' logic. Achieving custom automation still requires writing webhook handlers/code rather than declarative rule creation.
